Granite Point Capital Management Lp increased its stake in Marinus Pharmaceuticals Inc (MRNS) by 651.32% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 1.06 million shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $10.59 million, up from 141,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Granite Point Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Marinus Pharmaceuticals Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $160.73 million market cap company. The stock increased 6.62% or $0.19 during the last trading session, reaching $3.06. About 969,840 shares traded. Marinus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:MRNS) has declined 39.35% downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.35% the S&P500.

It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (Call) (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 14,000 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 66,000 shares, and cut its stake in Ishares China Large (FXI).
